comment: Brightness/Contrast opened on an empty layer over a red one, the canvas preview ticked, the red layer picked with the dialog open, contrast driven to 100 and Apply pressed. The canvas shows the filter on the red layer while the dialog is open, and Apply writes the red layer, so the texel read after Apply is the one the preview showed. Before the fix Apply wrote the empty layer and the red stayed at 0.9, 0.1, 0.05.
